title: Odd Reciprocal Binomial Expectation
statement: Let $J_m$ have the binomial distribution with parameters $m$ and $1/2$. Then $\frac{2m+1}{2}\,\mathbb{E}\!\left[\frac{1}{2J_m+1}\right]\to1$ as $m\to\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ ranges over nonnegative integers tending to infinity
